mapper.update: UPDATE audit_query_logs SET llm_provider_id = #{llmProviderId}, llm_provider_key = #{llmProviderKey}, llm_vendor_type = #{llmVendorType}, llm_model_code = #{llmModelCode}, llm_routing_version = #{llmRoutingVersion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.request_id AS request_id, a.question AS question, a.org_id AS org_id, o.org_name AS org_name, a.recommended_chart AS recommended_chart, a.rows_returned AS row_count, a.favorite_at AS favorited_at, a.created_at AS last_run_at FROM audit_query_logs a LEFT JOIN dim_org o ON a.org_id = o.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_favorite = true ORDER BY a.favorite_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.created_at DESC
